nodes.label: The Journey: whole homepage as one scroll-scrubbed 3D story
nodes.rationale: Owner asked for 3D beyond the hero; one fixed WebGL Stage with posters as fallbacks

nodes.label: 3D style is realistic (PBR)
nodes.rationale: Owner found primitives cartoonish; budgets kept via meshopt compression

nodes.label: One writer for every job move (writeTransition)
nodes.rationale: Timestamp, tracking event, status, audit, cash rows and POD in one transaction so they cannot drift

nodes.label: Courier balance counts only cash in hand
nodes.rationale: Mobile money goes to the company account, so riders must not be asked to hand over money they never held

nodes.label: Seeded roles read TANEX_PLAN 4.1 literally
nodes.rationale: Group name grants every key; tariffs.manage Super Admin only; stable seeded ids

nodes.label: Locked accounts get the generic sign-in error
nodes.rationale: Never confirm an account exists or is locked (OWASP)

nodes.label: Nobody can grant or change permissions they do not hold
nodes.rationale: Prevents a user manager resetting a Super Admin and signing in as them

nodes.label: Reset links built from APP_URL, never Host header
nodes.rationale: Prevents Host-header link poisoning; token in fragment stays out of logs

nodes.label: --ngf-* kept as aliases of --tx-* until I.3
nodes.rationale: Whole site re-skins at once without touching every component

nodes.label: URL decides the language; own typed dictionaries, French never in main bundle
nodes.rationale: No i18n library; missing keys fail the build

nodes.label: No demo data ships
nodes.rationale: Platform must hold only real records

nodes.label: Dispatch uses polling, not WebSockets; local shipments never auto-advance
nodes.rationale: Couriers are users with the Courier role plus a profile; jobs linked to TX shipments

nodes.label: Shop pictures cropped and resized in the browser; server checks exact sizes
Local tracking drops PII regardless of masking setting; area pins only
nodes.rationale: Protects customers and couriers on public tracking pages

nodes.label: Marketed network (gateways.ts) separate from tracking engine hubs (routingHubs.ts)
nodes.rationale: Routes of existing shipments do not move

hyperedges.label: Dispatch job lifecycle (booking to POD and cash)
